dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: left;\" trbidi=\"on\"\u003E\nSaturday june 6th 2020\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Ch2 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;Medicine intern log\u003C\/h2\u003E\n\u003Cdiv\u003E\nHello everyone,im a medical intern,and recently started my medicine posting.this blog is to share my medicine experiences and cases i come across during this period.\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nCASE\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nA 57 year oldfemale patient came with complaints of weakness of both lower limbs Since 3 months.\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Patient was apparently asymptomatic 3 months back when she is doing her routine daily work,she developed weakness of bilateral lower limbs which was sudden in onset.she went to a local hospital and treated by a local doctor but their was no improvement.sensory system is lost in both lower limbs from below the nipple.both the upper limbs are normal\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nNo h\/o upperlimb involvement\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nNo h\/o deviation of mouth\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nNo h\/o slurring of speech\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nNo h\/o urinary incontinence,\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nNo h\/o fever,loose stools\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EPast\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Ehistory\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nshe had a h\/o thyroid surgery 4 years back\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\nNo h\/o hypertension,diabetes mellitus\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: justify;\"\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EPersonal\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Ehistory: \u003C\/b\u003Ediet is mixed\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Appetite is regular\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Bowel and bladder are regular\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ENo significant family history\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPatient is c\/c\/c and oriented.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThin built and moderately nourished\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTemperature:afebrile\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPallor-absent\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nIcterus-absent\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo cyanosis,clubbing and lymphadenopathy\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBp:90\/60mmhg\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPR:75 bpm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCVS:S1 and S2 heard,no murmurs\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRS:BAE present NVBS\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nP\/A:soft and nontender,bowel sounds heard.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003ECNS EXAMINATION:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cbr
